reason_for_retention: The authorized source-discrepancy note adds essential prescribing clarification. The four sparse second pages contain only retained source/footer boilerplate; all clinical units pass. No cosmetic resizing or content deletion was introduced.
other_limits: Orange diamond anatomy numerals inherit a minor rotated-numeral presentation limitation from the approved PDF layout; all eight markers and their complete callouts remain distinct.
Full-page handbook chapter openers and complete source pages are intentional.
PDF/QR decoding does not establish browser/mobile functionality, live deployed destinations, phone-camera scanning or physical printing.
Example oncology telephone numbers and feasibility-review notices remain explicit and require replacement/clinical review before patient use.
Official NCCP source-table visual inspection was unavailable; this document visual review concerns locally generated patient PDFs only.
